name: Calvin Chestnut
bio: Calvin is an Apple enthusiast turned engineer who has been developing iOS apps in the Boston area for five years. After his college start-up was acquired he launched Drink Keeper, a HealthKit app for calculating Blood Alcohol Content. Today he is a Senior Software Engineer with WeedMaps, manages a Vapor and Swift backed server stack, and hosts the CastKit podcast on iOS Development and related tech topics. When not developing he can be found skateboarding to a meetup around Boston, playing Dungeons & Dragons with his college friends, or watching scary movies with his wife and cat at their home in Salem.
